'''Chrysolaria''' is a [[Fire]] type [[Healer]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Charflutter]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Chrysolaria prefers to stay alone up high, enjoying the view and occasionally scattering soothing, shimmering scales. It's just routine care for the Tatari at camp."

Chrysolaria is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.
